product.title: Five Over Stripe
product.description:
Our Five Over Stripe wallpaper is a classic print that balances crisp lines with inviting texture for a lived in feel. The expert craftsmen at our Dorset factory use a traditional dragging technique to apply stripes of our water based paint, giving each paper a subtle variance.
Full roll width is 53cm/21", roll length is 10m, stripe width is 5.6cm/2 1/4".
The image above and the colours listed are only a guide. To know for sure if this is the perfect paper for your project, please order a sample.
We recommend ordering all the rolls you need in one go because using traditional techniques and real paint, like we do, means pattern and colour can vary very slightly between batches.
